items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1958-06-19, 20
items.q: Well at that time, Peter Buchhosh was playing guitar with Charlie DeVoges.

ctx.x: Well at that time, Peter Buchhosh was playing guitar with Charlie DeVoges. He was a professor like mine. That's all down there on that canal down there. I was living there, right by the graveyard, I was living there with my cousin, little bit of fella, you know, call myself and they can plant him on there.
Is that the Whitney Avenue canal or Whitney Avenue, that canal you're talking about or what avenue?
